source_scope: Direct live PostgreSQL pg_ts_config, pg_ts_config_map, pg_ts_dict, pg_ts_parser, pg_ts_template catalog definitions; not native C compiled source or #267 Github code lines

sql_queries.dictionaries_parser_templates:
WITH x AS (
SELECT 'dictionary' kind,d.oid,n.nspname||'.'||d.dictname name,d.dicttemplate::oid::text source_id,
 coalesce(d.dictinitoption,'') def,
 jsonb_build_object('template_schema',tn.nspname,'template',t.tmplname,'options',d.dictinitoption,'description',pg_catalog.obj_description(d.oid,'pg_ts_dict')) aux
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict d JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.dictnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_ts_template t ON t.oid=d.dicttemplate JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid=t.tmplnamespace
UNION ALL
SELECT 'template',t.oid,n.nspname||'.'||t.tmplname,t.tmplinit::oid::text,
 coalesce(t.tmplinit::regproc::text,'null')||'|'||t.tmpllexize::regproc::text,
 jsonb_build_object('init',CASE WHEN t.tmplinit<>0 THEN t.tmplinit::regprocedure::text END,'lexize',t.tmpllexize::regprocedure::text,'description',pg_catalog.obj_description(t.oid,'pg_ts_template'))
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_template t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.tmplnamespace
UNION ALL
SELECT 'parser',t.oid,n.nspname||'.'||t.prsname,t.prsstart::oid::text,
 t.prsstart::regprocedure::text||'|'||t.prstoken::regprocedure::text||'|'||t.prsend::regprocedure::text||'|'||t.prsheadline::regprocedure::text||'|'||t.prslextype::regprocedure::text,
 jsonb_build_object('start',t.prsstart::regprocedure::text,'token',t.prstoken::regprocedure::text,'end',t.prsend::regprocedure::text,'headline',t.prsheadline::regprocedure::text,'lextype',t.prslextype::regprocedure::text,'description',pg_catalog.obj_description(t.oid,'pg_ts_parser'))
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.prsnamespace
) SELECT kind,oid,name,source_id,def,aux,md5(name||'|'||def||'|'||aux::text) md5 FROM x ORDER BY kind,name;
sql_queries.token_types: SELECT z.tokid,z.alias,z.description FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.ts_token_type(p.oid) z WHERE p.prsname='default' ORDER BY z.tokid;
sql_queries.statistics:
SELECT now()::text observed_at_utc, current_setting('default_text_search_config') default_tsearch,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config_map) map_total,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config_map WHERE mapseqno>1) chained,
(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.cfgnamespace WHERE n.nspname <> 'pg_catalog') custom_configs,
(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict d JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.dictnamespace WHERE n.nspname <> 'pg_catalog') extension_dictionaries,
(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private') AND (pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(c.oid) ILIKE '%tsvector%' OR pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(c.oid) ILIKE '%tsquery%')) app_fts_indexes;
